fields.description: Starline Beach Residences is a four-tower coastal apartment collection on Sobha Siniya Island in Umm Al Quwain. Its compact homes and larger duplexes have distinct layouts, with balconies or yards depending on the type. Tower A is specifically marketed as furnished in the original brochure; that specification should not be extended to every tower automatically.

research.community: Starline Beach Residences · Sobha Siniya Island
overview: The one-bedroom layouts focus on compact living, while three-bedroom duplexes add separate levels, service accommodation and a study. Compare the actual tower and type: garden-level yards, balconies and sea-facing positions are not identical throughout the collection.
research.locationNote: The official Starline page places it on Sobha Siniya Island, Umm Al Quwain. No existing catalogue location is substituted. Mainland connections and broader island facilities should be checked for delivery and access.
research.priceLabel: Developer-advertised starting guide · subject to stock
research.priceNote: The official enquiry section advertises AED 1.67m subject to inventory; its FAQ still cites approximately AED 1.29m and Property Finder retains a rounded AED 1.3m launch headline. These references differ in timing and selection, so the latest unit-specific written quotation is required.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder reports 20% booking, 40% construction and 40% handover. No current primary dated schedule was retrieved. Additional fees, revised offers and any resale balance are separate matters requiring written confirmation.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder reports June 2029, expressed as Q2 2029. This is a secondary estimated date and does not establish a contractual move-in date or completed facilities.
